en: \bFlint: How about if I tag along? I bet I can spice things up a bit.
\bFlint: See ya.
\bLucian: Ah, hello. You're here to pick me, too?
\bLucian: I'm more than happy to be of assistance.
\bLucian: Take care!
\rCynthia: It's time to show the world why I'm proud to be a Champion!
\rCynthia: Heheh, I knew you'd choose me.
\rCynthia: I'll be seeing you.
\bBarry: I'm gonna have to fine you a billion if you do not pick me!
\bBarry: Heh, so happy! I can't even keep a straight face right now!
\bBarry: I don't get it...
\rDawn: If you ever need help, I can be your mentor!
\rDawn: United like this, our dream team has no chance of losing!
\rDawn: Catch you later!
\bLucas: You and me are a dream team. Nobody can beat us!
\bLucas: You can bet I'll do my best!
\bLucas: Be seein' ya!
\bRowan: It's been a long while since I battled...
\bRowan: Let's have a look at this old man now...
\bRowan: Sure.
\bCyrus: The world should be complete. The world must change.
\bCyrus: Do you need my strength? Very well.
\bCyrus: Farewell
\bCilan: So, um, if you're OK with me...
\bCilan: I'll, um, put everything I've got into being, er, you know, your partner.
\bCilan: No hard feelings...
\bChili: Ta-da! That's me, a scorcher!
\bChili: Yeeeeooow! Time to play with FIRE!!
\bChili: Awwww!
\bCress: How exceedingly lucky for you to meet me.
\bCress: I see...
\rLenora: I'm going to research how we can seek victory!
\rLenora: Now, with that, let's start our road to victory!
\rLenora: No? Ok.
\bBurgh: No matter how many times we meet, I always discover something new about you.
\bBurgh: My Pokémon's buzzing to come along!
\bBurgh: See you around.
\rElesa: The world is my stage. Watch how the spotlight follows me.
\rElesa: Think you can keep up, sweetie?
\rElesa: Bye!
\bClay: I got more grit than anyone.
\bClay: Got some work to be done? I'm expectin' a bonus for this.
\bClay: I'll be seein' y'all!
\rSkyla: Whether you want to fly or blow your opponents away, you can count on me!
\rSkyla: Ready for takeoff!
\rSkyla: See you!
\bBrycen: The time is upon us. Use them to your advantage.
\bBrycen: I shall be honored to lend you a hand.
\bBrycen: I bid you farewell!
\rRoxie: Poison days, poison on the stage!
\rRoxie: We're gonna wow the crowd together!
\rRoxie: See ya.
\bCheren: I aim to be a wall for them to overcome.
\bCheren: Maybe I'll follow along for a while.
\bCheren: See you around.
\bDrayden: I've simply been pursuing greater strength.
\bDrayden: Show us the bright future.
\bDrayden: Moving on.
\bMarlon: We should totally go for a swim sometime, dude!
\bMarlon: Yo, I'll come along for the ride!
\bMarlon: Catch you later!
\bGrimsley: I guess you could say I'm a bit of a risk taker.
\bGrimsley: Following your lead seems like a good bet.
\bGrimsley: Until we meet again.
\rShauntal: Would this pairing be the subject of my new novel?
\rShauntal: This could write a best-seller about us!
\rShauntal: Bye!
\bMarshal: I dedicate my life and soul to mastering the art of battle.
\bMarshal: Count me in.
\bMarshal: See ya around.
\rCaitlin: Who is so uncouth as to disturb my sleep?
\rCaitlin: Please, try not to bore me.
\rCaitlin: *giggle*
\bAlder: Take deep breaths and relax both your body and spirit.
\bAlder: Farewell!
\bBenga: Let's pursue our goals together!
\bBenga: Let's head out!
\bBenga: Bye!
\rIris: People call me the girl who knows the hearts of dragons!
\rIris: Are you going out now? I wanna go, too!
